english.note: A woman uses this when she weds someone, rather than the gender-neutral construction.
Use 嫁 when the subject is a woman marrying a man.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 gaa3 laa3

examples.english: She decided to marry at twenty-five.
examples.traditional: 佢二十五歲先決定嫁人。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ji6 sap6 ng5 seoi3 sin1 kyut3 ding6 gaa3 jan4
